name: YouTube Music (mpv)
author: Symon Baikov
description: Browse your YouTube Music playlists from the bar and play them through a headless mpv. No browser window needed: yt-dlp reads your saved login cookies from disk.

barWidget.description: Click to browse playlists and control playback; right-click to play / pause; middle-click for the next track.

schema.label: Browser to read login cookies from
schema.description: yt-dlp --cookies-from-browser value: chromium, brave, firefox, chrome, vivaldi, edge, opera, e.g. "brave:Profile 1", or a Firefox-fork profile folder such as "firefox:~/.config/zen/<profile>". The browser does not need to be running. Use "none" for public playlists only.

schema.label: Use cookies for playback
schema.description: Turn on only if private uploads or members-only tracks fail to play. Off is faster and avoids sign-in checks.

schema.label: Show track title in the bar
